definitions.baselines: standing_me = K.start('standing','me'); mu = Q-process stationary law on the reachable transient states.
definitions.best_name: argmax ratio enrichment over classes with E >= 2.0 (standing b) and excess s - b >= 0.05; None = unnamed.
definitions.class: N1 lexicon body region of the FINISHING submission (structured type + targetArea); finisher columns joined by hub id.
definitions.core_halo: core = territory hubs with a state whose hand finishes in class C directly or by a chain (R_C > 0); halo = the rest.
definitions.fit: score_pairs: precision/recall/F1/lift, hypergeometric upper tail, whole-family BH — EXPLORATORY (uniform-node null; graph-derived sets are dependent); mu_* = mu-weighted, no weighted p.
definitions.hub_start: uniform over the hub's 4 transient states {top, bottom} x {my turn, their turn}.
definitions.robustness: fraction of K.perturbed(0.2, 0.2, seed), seeds 0..199, keeping the claim (own recomputed baseline); plus origin=False, shipped rule, gi frame. Not a probability of being right.
definitions.role_start: 1/2 (role-node, my turn) + 1/2 (role-node, their turn); me / them = performer.
definitions.seat_share: TOP / BOTTOM = finishes by the player who STARTED on that seat (hub start law).
definitions.share: P(roll ends by a class-C finish | roll ends decided), from the stated start law; both performers pooled unless named.
definitions.territory: R_C(theta; baseline, scale) = universe hubs with enrichment >= theta; ratio = s/b (spec; bounded by 1/b), odds = [s/(1-s)]/[b/(1-b)].
definitions.time: Exit shares at H = infinity do not depend on steps vs plies; the clocked figures use the kernel's plies (one card, 0 for a stay-put miss) with H uniform over 9..12 plies, the app's clock length (maxMoves). That is not the app's own move clock, which counts moveCount (app_game.py).
definitions.tv_regions: gs-3's accepted exit-TV k-medoids territories (gs-shared.md §8; geometry.json), keyed tv:<medoid>, named here by the same rule from a uniform start over each region; robustness holds the member set FIXED.
definitions.universe: hubs with BOTH role-nodes reachable from standing in the configuration's kernel.

gi_only_guards.set_definition: positions in the gi universe (both seats reachable from standing, gi/symmetric) and not in the no-gi one; enrichment = class share of the rolls that end (hub start law) / the same class's share from standing in gi

definition.baseline: per-player beta_C = b_C / 2 (b_C = pooled standing share, me first); variants: standing_seat (the standing hub's own seat shares), mu_per_player (b_mu / 2). Seat enrichment = hubs[h].seat_share[sigma][C] / baseline_per_player[C].
definition.gates: (C, sigma) passes when S^sigma_C >= 2.0 x beta_C and S^sigma_C - beta_C >= 0.05.
definition.proposition_5: lane-gs-5.md N3: (a) both seats pass => pooled passes; (b) pooled E >= theta => some seat E >= theta; (c) pooled excess >= 2 delta => some seat excess >= delta; (d) seat ceiling 2/b; (e) symmetric rule: S^TOP(h) = coin 'me' share of h/top.
definition.rule: refine-only: a pooled (N2R) name keeps its class and gains qualifier BOTH / TOP / BOTTOM / SHARED (seats passing for that class); an unnamed hub gains 'C for the sigma player' (largest seat enrichment); else unnamed.
definition.seat_share: S^sigma_C(h) = P(roll ends by a class-C finish performed by the player who STARTED on seat sigma | decided), hub start law; S^TOP + S^BOTTOM = pooled share.
